learner: 17-18 yr old Indian 12th-grader, limited English, no technical background
objectives: Explain in plain words what RAG is
Explain why LLMs alone give outdated or made-up answers
Describe the steps of a RAG system in order

key_concepts.concept: LLMs only know their training data (cutoff) and lack private data
Chunking, and WHY (LLM can read only limited text at once)
Embeddings: meaning as numbers; similar meaning = similar numbers
Retrieval: find the closest chunks to the question
Augmentation: put question + chunks into the prompt
Generation: LLM answers using the provided text
Limits: RAG reduces but does not remove errors; bad retrieval gives bad answers
RAG does not retrain the model; update knowledge by changing documents
